goal: Turn the owner conversation into bounded goals and a clear, continuous account of actual work.
acceptance: One owner-facing answer remains coherent across worker handoffs.
Jobs carry explicit input refs, acceptance checks and bounded tokens/time/cost.
Skipped, failed, estimated and verified states are distinct; no private reasoning transcript is requested.
prompt: Use the accepted goal and supplied ledger. Reuse a suitable employee, issue the smallest useful task packet, and report evidence, blocker and next action. Keep unrelated company material out of the packet.
